categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the digital X-ray core components and integrated solutions sector, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of digital X-ray detectors, high-voltage generators, integrated X-ray sources, and X-ray tubes. Its products serve medical diagnostics and treatment, industrial non-destructive testing, and security inspection fields. The business is divided mainly into medical and industrial product lines, including static and dynamic digital detectors, dental imaging, mammography, radiotherapy, and industrial inspection detectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses proprietary technologies in sensor design and manufacturing, including amorphous silicon, IGZO, CMOS, and flexible substrate sensors. It has advanced capabilities in scintillator materials and packaging, readout chips, low-noise electronics, intelligent X-ray detection, and image correction algorithms. Production methods include precision coating of cesium iodide scintillators, OCA coupling, and advanced assembly processes for X-ray tubes and high-voltage generators. The company also develops integrated solutions combining hardware, software, and applications, supported by a comprehensive R&D system and quality management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global and domestic X-ray imaging equipment manufacturers in medical and industrial sectors. Medical customers cover general radiography, dental, mammography, radiotherapy, and veterinary imaging equipment makers. Industrial customers include manufacturers in battery inspection, semiconductor packaging, casting inspection, pipeline weld inspection, and food safety. The company has established long-term partnerships with leading firms such as GE Healthcare, Siemens, Philips, Konica Minolta, and domestic leaders like United Imaging and Mindray.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with sales and service platforms in over 80 countries and regions, including Asia, the Americas, Europe, and Africa. It has established overseas sales and customer service centers in the United States, Germany, South Korea, India, Japan, Mexico, Pakistan, Brazil, and South Africa. Its production bases are located in China (Shanghai, Taicang, Haining, Hefei, Chengdu) and overseas subsidiaries in Europe, the US, Korea, and Hong Kong, forming a '1 headquarters + 6 bases' global layout.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream of the X-ray imaging equipment supply chain, manufacturing core components such as digital detectors, high-voltage generators, X-ray tubes, and integrated X-ray sources. It maintains close relationships with upstream suppliers of critical raw materials like sensors, chips, scintillators, and structural parts, and provides integrated solutions to downstream equipment manufacturers who assemble final X-ray imaging systems for medical and industrial applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in digital X-ray detector technologies, including CMOS, IGZO, flexible substrates, photon counting, and CT detectors. It invests heavily in R&D, with a focus on new core components like high-voltage generators, micro-focus X-ray tubes, and integrated solutions. Strategic priorities include expanding product platforms, enhancing supply chain autonomy by developing upstream materials, and advancing AI-enabled imaging technologies. The company also pursues global market expansion and aims to become a leading global X-ray product and solution provider.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of digital X-ray detectors, core X-ray components (high-voltage generators, X-ray tubes, integrated sources), and integrated technical solutions and services. The company mainly uses a direct sales model supplemented by distributors, selling to X-ray imaging equipment manufacturers who incorporate these components into final products. Additional income arises from licensing, government subsidies, and investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few global manufacturers mastering all key digital X-ray detector technologies and holds a leading market share domestically and internationally. Major global competitors include Varian Medical Systems, Trixell, Hamamatsu Photonics, and Dunlee in core components. The company has broken foreign monopolies in several segments and is recognized as a leading domestic supplier with strong R&D and localized service advantages. It is ranked first in China for digital X-ray detector market share and holds about 20% global market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.83 billion, a slight decrease of 1.74% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 465 million, down 23.43%. Total assets reached RMB 9.08 billion, up 20.92%, with net assets of RMB 4.64 billion, up 7.12%. R&D investment increased to 16.94% of revenue. The company has shown steady growth in production and sales volumes, expanding global footprint and product lines, supported by significant capital expenditures and financing activities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers highly advanced, reliable, and cost-effective digital X-ray core components with proprietary technologies across multiple sensor platforms, enabling superior image quality, lower radiation doses, and enhanced clinical and industrial application performance. Its vertically integrated supply chain and comprehensive product portfolio provide customers with differentiated, customizable solutions and faster service response. The company’s commitment to innovation, quality certifications, and global service network underpin its competitive advantage and customer trust.
